sentence: This project provides computing equipment for solving complex scientific and technical problems in areas such as neuroscience, chemistry, and psychology.
This project brings together experts to study how artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and quantum information science affect cyber resilience.
This project studies how attaching a polymer to a protein makes the protein more robust and tries to create rules for designing such molecules.
This project builds data-driven tools that support learning of logic, probability, and programming through problem solving with artificial intelligence.
This project studies advanced technologies for aviation, marine propulsion, and power generation, including fluid mechanics, heat transfer, combustion, and battery storage.
This project studies how a group of schools, colleges, and industry partners can share resources to teach automation, industrial controls, and robotics.
This project studies how whole genome duplication shapes crop resilience and productivity, using machine learning on plant genomes.
This project builds software tools that protect quantum emulation from cyberattacks and studies how induced noise affects its accuracy.
This project develops software that uses artificial intelligence to turn MRI scans of tumors into three dimensional models.
This project designs and runs quantum algorithms on quantum computers built with trapped atomic ions.
This project develops a low-cost method that makes tiny patterns on materials through self-assembly of tiny building blocks.
This project combines ultrasonic sensors with optical sensors to improve computer vision and robotic mapping.
This project builds tools that find errors and safely rewrite deep learning programs so they run reliably and efficiently.
This project builds methods that compress data and send it efficiently between many devices, using generative models and learning.
This project tests whether clues can predict when ecosystems flip abruptly from one state to another, using rocky shores.
